subject: Post-call: traffic stress cases, sample payloads, and POC owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa@stratalabs.com>, StrataLabs SRE <sre@stratalabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: traffic stress cases, sample payloads, and POC owners

Hi Alyssa / Strata SRE — thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned going into the POC: 

Summary of what we captured on the call:
- Primary use case: conversational customer support (multi-turn chat) with fallback to knowledge retrieval on longer queries.
- 95th percentile request shape: ~3 messages per session, avg user prompt 120 tokens, model response avg 240 tokens.
- Peak pattern: 10–15 minute bursts at roughly 250–300 RPS for autocomplete endpoints; background steady state ~8 RPS for async batch jobs.
- SLAs required: p50 latency target <250ms for short-token generation (<=128 tokens), and <800ms for longer responses; availability target 99.9% during business hours.

Required items to start the POC (please send these by EOD Monday):
1) Representative traffic sample (CSV) with at least 48 hours of timestamps + endpoint, request token length, response token length, and session id.
2) Any redacted example prompts that are latency-sensitive (clear indicators of low/high cost behaviors).
3) Success criteria doc: what metrics will mark the POC a success (e.g., p95 latency, inference cost per 1k requests, model quality thresholds).

What Redwood will deliver for the trial:
- Dedicated test slice with pinned model variant and telemetry configured for token-level cost and per-route latency.
- Proof-run of burst scenarios (using your sample) and a short report with perf/cost trade-offs and quantization recommendations.
- Hand-off checklist for production if trial meets targets.

Owners / proposed assignments:
- Redwood SRE & onboarding lead: Monica Patel (will own telemetry + run bursts)
- Redwood inference performance: Priyom Das (capacity/quantization recommendations)
- Strata POC lead: Alyssa Gomez (traffic/success sign-off)

Alyssa: can you confirm the two burst windows you expect (timezones) and attach the traffic CSV and any success criteria template you prefer? I attached a short POC success metrics template to this thread for convenience.

Attachments: poc-success-metrics-template.docx (blank template)

Thanks — looking forward to getting the ingest started.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
Attachment: poc-success-metrics-template.docx (DOCX, 28KB)

Subject: Re: Post-call: traffic stress cases, sample payloads, and POC owners

Ben / team — thanks for the notes and clear owner callouts. Confirming the items below and attaching the traffic sample as requested.

Answers / files:
- Burst windows: typically 08:30–08:45 PT and 17:20–17:35 PT (business hours heavy). We also expect a weekend spike on Sunday afternoon for scheduled batch exports (~150 RPS).
- Attached: stratalabs-traffic-sample.csv (contains 72 hours of anonymized records; columns: timestamp, endpoint, request_tokens, response_tokens, session_id).
- Success criteria: our internal target is p95 latency <650ms for production traffic, and cost not to exceed $0.09 per 1k tokens for inference during the trial. I've filled the poc-success-metrics-template.docx and attached it as well.

Known caveats:
- The sample includes a small subset of retrieval-heavy prompts that expand response tokens by ~2.5x; mark those as "retrieval" in the CSV column comment.
- We will redact any PII but keep session ids consistent.

Next steps: once you confirm receipt, can you (Monica / Priyom) schedule the burst test window for Tuesday morning 09:00–09:30 PT? We are ready to provide short-lived elevated creds for the test slice.

Regards,
Alyssa
Alyssa Gomez
Head of Platform | StrataLabs
alyssa@stratalabs.com

- Configure per-route token-level cost and p95/p99 latency dashboards.

- Deliver a preliminary report by Wed EOD with observed latencies, token costs, and any failed requests.

Actions for Priyom (inference perf)

Ownership notes: keep Alyssa updated on exact test time and ephemeral creds. If either of you see the retrieval-heavy rows causing >2x p95 inflation, call an immediate pause and we’ll adjust routing to a fallback cheaper variant.
